newsitem.title: USA: Dissident Rexene holders backed by ISS.
newsitem.headline: Dissident Rexene holders backed by ISS.

text.p: Dissident Rexene Corp shareholders Wyser-Pratte & Co Inc and Spear, Leeds & Kellogg said Monday that Institutional Shareholder Services Inc had endorsed their call for Rexene shareholders to vote in favor of delaying a special shareholder meeting set for April 30.

ISS said in a report, "We believe it would not be productive to convene the special meeting on April 30, but to postpone it to give shareholders an opportunity to evaluate ...recent development(s) and...forthcoming negotiations," according to a press release from Wyser-Pratte and Spear, Leeds.

The developments to which ISS referred apparently include last week's announcement that Rexene had signed a confidentiality agreement with privately-held Huntsman Corp that would facilitate due diligence proceedings for Huntsman's $16-per-share buyout offer of Rexene.
Wyser-Pratte and Spear, Leeds said ISS backed postponement of the special shareholder vote until May 22.
"We concur with Wyser-Pratte's suggested recommencement date of May 22 and its proposed extension of the Dutch-auction deadline," the ISS report said, according to Wyser-Pratte and Spear, Leeds.
"Wyser-Pratte and Spear, Leeds will also solicit proxies only to postpone the special meeting and has suspended its efforts to replace the Rexene board or to pass its bylaw proposals.
"They have also asked shareholders to withhold or abstain on those issues," the dissident shareholders said in the press release.

Quoting from its April 25 letter sent to Rexene shareholders, the dissident group reiterated that "if Rexene and Huntsman come to terms in the next month, we will have no need to proceed with our proxy effort to replace the board and we will simply withdraw our solicitation."
